name: binhex-slskd
description: A modern client-server application for the Soulseek file-sharing network.

paths.name: /config
paths.description: This is the container path to your configuration files, e.g. databases, configuration files, logs etc.

paths.name: /media
paths.description: This is the container path to your media files, e.g. movies, tv, music, pictures etc.

paths.name: /data
paths.description: This is the container path to your downloaded files or user created content.

ports.name: HTTP Web Interface
ports.description: This is the HTTP Web UI port for the application.

ports.name: HTTPS Web Interface
ports.description: This is the HTTPS Web UI port for the application.

variables.name: SLSK_USERNAME
variables.description: Username for the Soulseek network.

variables.name: SLSK_PASSWORD
variables.description: Password for the Soulseek network.

variables.name: SLSK_LISTEN_PORT
variables.description: Port on which to listen for incoming connections.

variables.name: SHARED_PATHS
variables.description: Semi-colon separated list of container paths to shared files. !!WARNING!! Be careful not to share sensitive information.

variables.name: INCOMPLETE_PATH
variables.description: The container path where incomplete downloads are saved.

variables.name: DOWNLOADS_PATH
variables.description: The container path where downloaded files are saved.

variables.name: UPLOAD_SPEED_LIMIT
variables.description: Upload speed limit in bits/s.

variables.name: DOWNLOAD_SPEED_LIMIT
variables.description: Download speed limit in bits/s.

variables.name: WEBUI_HTTP_PORT
variables.description: HTTP port for web UI.

variables.name: WEBUI_HTTPS_PORT
variables.description: HTTPS port for web UI.

variables.name: WEBUI_USERNAME
variables.description: Username for web UI authentication.

variables.name: WEBUI_PASSWORD
variables.description: Password for web UI authentication.

variables.name: API_KEY
variables.description: API key for slskd API access, string between 16 and 255 characters, you can use the command 'openssl rand -hex 16' to generate a randomised string.

variables.name: REMOTE_CONFIGURATION
variables.description: Allow remote configuration (true/false).

variables.name: REMOTE_FILE_MANAGEMENT
variables.description: Allow remote file management (true/false).

variables.name: GLUETUN_INCOMING_PORT
variables.description: Specify whether to attempt to identify and configure the applications listening port when connected to the gluetun network.

variables.name: GLUETUN_CONTROL_SERVER_PORT
variables.description: Specify the port for the gluetun HTTP Control Server.

variables.name: GLUETUN_CONTROL_SERVER_USERNAME
variables.description: Specify the username for the gluetun HTTP Control Server

variables.name: GLUETUN_CONTROL_SERVER_PASSWORD
variables.description: Specify the password for the gluetun HTTP Control Server

variables.name: ENABLE_HEALTHCHECK
variables.description: Enable or disable healthchecks.

variables.name: HEALTHCHECK_COMMAND
variables.description: The command or script to execute, if not specified then the script healthcheck.sh will be used (process, dns and https checking).

variables.name: HEALTHCHECK_ACTION
variables.description: The action to execute if the healthcheck command returns a non zero exit code, if not specified the action will be 'exit 1', if you want the container to exit on failure then set the action to 'kill 1'.

variables.name: HEALTHCHECK_HOSTNAME
variables.description: The hostname used when performing HTTPS and DNS healthchecking.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID for the running container

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID for the running container

variables.name: UMASK
variables.description: UMASK for the running container

author: binhex
